{{Quote|Here you go, General. We're more than happy to let this one be your responsibility.|Unidentified officer to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="TSC" />}}
This '''individual''' was an officer on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]]. Sometime in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the officer assisted in the arrest of the criminal [[T'mott Zoat]] after a lengthy pursuit by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]  [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] that culminated in a [[Skirmish at Traygura’s Hideout|skirmish]] at the [[Traygura's hideout|hideout]] of the crime boss [[Traygura]]. The officer handed over Zoat, with his mouth and hands bound, to Kenobi in order to be transported to [[Helleguth]].<ref name="TSC" />
